newsitem.title: USA: US stocks up solidly as budget deal appears near.
newsitem.headline: US stocks up solidly as budget deal appears near.

text.p: Wall Street stocks powered to session highs in mid-afternoon, helped by mounting expectations that a U.S. budget deal would soon be announced.
The Dow industrials rose 51 points or 0.7 percent to 7027. Index-arbitrage curbs remain in effect on the NYSE.
Tech stocks and small caps continued to outperform, with the Nasdaq Composite and Russell 2000 index each up nearly two percent.
"It looks like we're minutes away from a deal," said Bill Meehan, market analyst at Prudential Securities.
"A deal would help the bond market psychologically and in all likelihood would lift the stock market too," he said.
Advancing issues widened their lead over decliners to three-to-one on active NYSE volume of about 380 million shares.
